answer: Here is one mechanism that works: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because spiral only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, terrace is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any lagoon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
